extension_points: Design extension boundary: Handwritten entity schema/registrations generate mechanical enumeration and persistent record codecs.
Design extension boundary: Entity-specific validation/deletion rules live in schema/features, never the generic coordinator.
state_failure_version_rules: Reference evidence remains L1_draft. This file documents actual public declarations separately from design names; no fresh consumer/BP execution, L2 or full SK/P0 acceptance is asserted.
All document mutation uses the shared coordinator, document/epoch/revision checks and atomic persistent history; GUI/script/AI cannot bypass it.
Unimplemented advanced capabilities report unavailable; data/reference errors never become a partially committed model.
Design/acceptance obligation: Validation rejects missing/type/unit/range/ref/future-version inputs without model/history changes.
Design/acceptance obligation: Type/field persistent IDs do not depend on registrar order.
Design/acceptance obligation: A new optional field has an explicit old-schema default; incompatible changes require migration.
Design/acceptance obligation: Undo/redo and persistence traverse the same declared field/ref representation.

Registry add/add_rule/freeze are trusted startup mutations; after freeze catalog mutation rejects. decode/from_input/make<T> can throw RecordError, including schema_unsupported/invalid_input. Descriptor versions/defaults govern decoding; model publication uses the coordinator.
